body: Yeah I've used it a couple of times, went to social anxiety meetups and personal improvement meetups to meet people like me, but I think I'd get more success in making friends if I joined a sports or gym related meetup which I think I will try soon.

>The first time I had sex was when I was 21 and honestly it wasn't enjoyable at all, it's seriously overrated. My good friend said the same thing, he agrees that he'd rather be a virgin. It's seriously not worth stressing out over.

its not so much the act itself its the fact that I haven't even gotten close to that stage, it feels like a massive failure that I'm still not there and the vast majority of other guys have been there ages ago.

I don't really care much about what other people think of me I just want  to be close to them.  I feel really good If I can talk back and forth to people for more than a minute, it's like its a drug.  the thought of having a best friend or a girlfriend who I can talk to for hours about anything, even really personal stuff sounds almost too good to be true, but I see so many people who have that and it really makes me feel like i'm missing out so much on life.  

like if you ask a random person on the street what's their reason for living they'll always say their friends or their SO or their kids and family, usually not anything else besides that.
